question: Which Japanese-themed book from my Amazon gift order hasn't shipped yet and is still waiting to be sent?

steps.text: Plan: find the Amazon order email(s) for taylor-m, identify the Japanese-themed books, then see which one's shipping status is "not yet shipped."

steps.arguments: {"query": "Amazon.com order gift Japanese book not yet shipped"}
steps.summary: 10 results, 10 of them people's own mail

The 2000-11-18 shipment email lists a Japanese-themed item as not yet shipped, but the title is cut off. I'll look for the original order confirmation to get the full title.

steps.text: I've got the full title of Tim's book from his Christmas list, and the order lines up with those four titles. I'll run one search to see whether a later shipment went out.
The Christmas list gives the full title. Before I answer, I'll check whether a later email says it shipped.

steps.arguments: {"query": "Black Mist Japanese Futures shipped, completes your order", "since": "2000-11-18", "until": "2001-03-31", "source": "mail"}
steps.summary: 10 results, 10 of them people's own mail, 4 repeats left out

answer:
The book is *Black Mist and Other Japanese Futures*, and the mail doesn't show that it ever shipped. The title in Amazon's email is cut off at "Black Mist and Other Japanese," so the full title comes from a second email.

- **The order email:** On 2000-11-18 Amazon sent a partial-shipment notice for order #102-0833775-0349758. It said "we shipped this portion of your gift separately to give your gift recipient the speediest service possible." That shipment held Future on Ice, Enchantment, and Heartfire: The Tales of Alvin Maker.
- **The item still waiting:** The same email says the following items will ship separately, as soon as they're available: 1 "Black Mist and Other Japanese" at $7.84, listed as "Not Yet Shipped." The email adds that you only pay for items when they ship.
- **The full title:** The truncated name matches a Christmas list that Timothy Taylor sent on 1999-12-01. It asks for "Black Mist & Other Japanese Futures," Orson Scott Card (ed.) along with Enchantment, Future on Ice and Heartfire. Those are the same four books as in the order.
- **Whether it shipped later:** I searched for a later "completes your order" email and found none. That could mean the mailbox doesn't hold it, so I can't confirm it never shipped.
